# Ankush Yadav

> AI product builder in India. Takes products from idea to working software: Android, web, backend and AI. Five products, each with an interactive demo on this site (demos are simulations on sample data).

## What he builds
- Android apps: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, AGSL shaders, accessibility and foreground services, Capacitor, React Native / Expo.
- Web and servers: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, Hono, Express, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, SQLite with vector search, Firebase.
- AI products: voice assistants, LLM orchestration with Claude and Gemini, on-device models, long-term memory.

## Products (status as shown on the site)
- Strikedeck (built, paper trading only; not investment advice): options research and paper-trading desk for Indian markets. Live broker ticks, engine consensus, safety gate, paper-to-live promotion. React, Express 5, Socket.IO, PostgreSQL, Flutter clients. 1,871 source files, 763 test files.
- Mikazuki (built, v1.0, personal use): a voice operating system for one person on Android. Wake word, cloud and on-device brains, vector memory, on-phone execution. Kotlin, Compose, Bun, Hono, sqlite-vec.
- Sri Hari Docs (built for a client): truck paperwork for an agri-trading company. Photograph, extract, match the right truck, complete paper trail. React, Capacitor, Firebase. Hindi and English.
- ShopConnect (prototype, simulated): offline Android retail demo with four roles and one simulated order. Expo 58, React Native, TypeScript.
- Business toolkit (in development, name withheld until launch): zero-budget programme with research, two-checker fact-checking, a repository validator with 14 tests, and an owner approval gate before any build phase.
